newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican Energy buys Iowa security firm stake.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican Energy buys Iowa security firm stake.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Holdings Co said Tuesday its MidAmerican Capital Co unit bought a controlling stake in Diversified Electronics Ltd, the parent of AAA Security Systems Inc.

MidAmerican said the purchase was part of a long-term strategy to provide customers with products and services that complement its energy services. No operational changes at AAA Security are planned, MidAmerican said.
MidAmerican is a utility and investment holding company.
Its shares were trading up 1/8 Tuesday at 16-3/8.
